title.th: การแต่งตั้งเจ้าหน้าที่ออกใบอนุญาต

completenessNote: 该法规为单篇法律文书，无分节结构；正文按官方 front 抬头逐字全录，共 1 条。

text.en:
Sand and Granite Quarries Act
(CHAPTER 284, Section 3)
Appointment of Licensing Officer
N 1
REVISED EDITION 2001
(31st January 2001)
[26th May 1999]
The Minister for National Development has appointed the Director, Business Development Division, Building and Construction Authority, to be the Licensing Officer for the purposes of the Act.
